name: Kogawa Youzou
source: Keigo's new boss, a cheerful middle-aged man. Though he appears unremarkable at first glance, he’s a powerhouse who climbed to executive level at a major corporation. Also not to be underestimated – he married a young, beautiful wife. Suffers from erectile dysfunction and asked Keigo to "share" intimate duties with his wife.
